# quicknode_stream (Resource)

A Quicknode Stream. It delivers blockchain data from a network to one or more destinations.

Quicknode can stop a stream by itself: `terminated` when a destination keeps failing or the account's plan no longer allows it, and `completed` after it delivers `end_range`. `state` reports which. For a terminated stream the plan changes `status` back to the configured value, and applying it resumes or pauses the stream. A completed stream can't be changed or resumed, so any change replaces it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "archive_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "archive_sas_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "database_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "kafka_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "quicknode_stream" "transfers" {
  name    = "usdc-transfers"
  network = "ethereum-mainnet"
  dataset = "receipts"
  region  = "usa_east"
  status  = "active"

  # The filter is plain source; the provider encodes it for the API.
  filter_function = file("${path.module}/filter.js")

  # Stay behind the newest block so reorganized blocks are never delivered.
  keep_distance_from_tip = 3

  destination = {
    webhook = {
      url     = "https://ingest.example.com/quicknode"
      headers = { "X-Source" = "quicknode-streams" }
    }
  }

  # Every batch is also delivered to each of these. The stream moves on only
  # after every destination accepts a batch.
  extra_destinations = [
    {
      s3 = {
        bucket        = "chain-archive"
        region        = "us-east-1"
        object_prefix = "usdc-transfers/"
        compression   = "gzip"
        access_key    = "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"
        secret_key    = var.archive_secret_key
      }
    },
    {
      azure = {
        storage_account = "chainarchive"
        container       = "usdc-transfers"
        file_type       = ".parquet"
        sas_token       = var.archive_sas_token
      }
    },
    {
      postgres = {
        host       = "db.example.com"
        database   = "chain"
        table_name = "usdc_transfers"
        username   = "streams"
        password   = var.database_password
      }
    },
    {
      kafka = {
        bootstrap_servers = "broker-1.example.com:9092,broker-2.example.com:9092"
        topic_name        = "usdc-transfers"
        protocol          = "sasl_ssl"
        mechanisms        = "SCRAM-SHA-512"
        username          = "streams"
        password          = var.kafka_password
      }
    },
  ]
}

# Quicknode signs each webhook request with this token, so the receiver can
# check it came from Quicknode.
output "webhook_security_token" {
  value     = quicknode_stream.transfers.destination.webhook.security_token
  sensitive = true
}

# A backfill of a fixed block range. It stops as completed after end_range,
# and any later change replaces it.
resource "quicknode_stream" "backfill" {
  name        = "usdc-transfers-backfill"
  network     = "ethereum-mainnet"
  dataset     = "receipts"
  region      = "usa_east"
  status      = "active"
  start_range = 21000000
  end_range   = 21100000

  dataset_batch_size = 10

  filter_function = file("${path.module}/filter.js")

  destination = {
    webhook = {
      url         = "https://ingest.example.com/quicknode/backfill"
      compression = "gzip"
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `dataset` (String) What each batch carries, for example `block`, `block_with_receipts`, `receipts`, `logs`, `transactions` or `trace_blocks`. The datasets available depend on the network. Changing it replaces the stream.
- `destination` (Attributes) Where the stream delivers. Set exactly one type. Changing the type replaces the stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination))
- `name` (String) Name shown in the dashboard. Names are not unique.
- `network` (String) Network slug, for example `ethereum-mainnet` or `solana-devnet`. Changing it replaces the stream.
- `region` (String) Region the stream runs in: `usa_east`, `europe_central` or `asia_east`. Changing it replaces the stream.
- `status` (String) `active` or `paused`. Required, so importing a stream never starts or stops it.

### Optional

- `dataset_batch_size` (Number) Blocks per batch. Some fast networks require a larger minimum. Defaults to `1`.
- `elastic_batch_enabled` (Boolean) Grow batches while the stream catches up to the newest block. Only allowed without `end_range`. Defaults to `false`.
- `end_range` (Number) Last block to deliver. When set, the stream stops as `completed` after delivering it. When omitted, the stream runs until it is paused or deleted.
- `extra_destinations` (Attributes List) More destinations that receive every batch, each set like `destination`. Types can repeat. The stream moves on only after every destination accepts a batch, and stops if one keeps failing. The limit depends on the account's plan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--extra_destinations))
- `filter_function` (String) Source code of the filter that shapes each batch, as plain text. Read it from a file with `file("filter.js")`. Quicknode runs the filter against `start_range` when the stream is created and rejects the stream if it fails.
- `filter_language` (String) Language of `filter_function`: `javascript` or `go`. Defaults to `javascript`.
- `fix_block_reorgs` (Boolean) Deliver corrected blocks when the network reorganizes. Depends on the account's plan. Defaults to `false`.
- `keep_distance_from_tip` (Number) Stay this many blocks behind the newest block, so reorganized blocks are never delivered. Depends on the account's plan.
- `notification_email` (String) Address notified when the stream is terminated.
- `restream_batch_on_reorg` (Boolean) Deliver the whole batch again when a block in it is reorganized.
- `resume_from` (String) Where a paused or terminated stream continues when `status` changes to `active`: `last` continues after the last block delivered, `latest` skips ahead to the newest block. `latest` moves `start_range`, so it cannot be combined with a configured `start_range`. Defaults to `last`.
- `start_range` (Number) First block to deliver. When omitted, the stream starts at the newest block and this attribute reports which one. Changing it moves the stream to that block, which can deliver blocks again or skip them.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stream id.
- `state` (String) The stream's actual status: `active`, `paused`, `terminated` or `completed`.

<a id="nestedatt--destination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination`

Optional:

- `azure` (Attributes) Write each batch as a blob to Azure Storage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination--azure))
- `kafka` (Attributes) Produce each batch as messages to a Kafka topic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination--kafka))
- `postgres` (Attributes) Insert each batch into a PostgreSQL table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination--postgres))
- `s3` (Attributes) Write each batch as an object to Amazon S3 or an S3-compatible store. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination--s3))
- `webhook` (Attributes) Deliver each batch as an HTTP POST. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination--webhook))

<a id="nestedatt--destination--azure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination.azure`

Required:

- `container` (String) Container name.
- `sas_token` (String, Sensitive) Shared access signature token with write access to the container.
- `storage_account` (String) Storage account name.

Optional:

- `blob_prefix` (String) Prefix added to each blob name. Defaults to ``.
- `compression` (String) `none` or `gzip`. Defaults to `none`.
- `file_type` (String) `.json` or `.parquet`. Defaults to `.json`.
- `max_retry` (Number) Delivery attempts before the stream is terminated. Defaults to `3`.
- `retry_interval_sec` (Number) Seconds between delivery attempts. Defaults to `1`.


<a id="nestedatt--destination--kafka"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination.kafka`

Required:

- `bootstrap_servers` (String) Comma-separated `host:port` list of brokers.
- `topic_name` (String) Topic the messages are produced to.

Optional:

- `batch_size` (Number) Producer batch size in bytes. Defaults to `16384`.
- `compression` (String) `none`, `gzip`, `snappy`, `lz4` or `zstd`. Defaults to `zstd`.
- `linger_ms` (Number) Milliseconds the producer waits to fill a batch. Defaults to `5`.
- `max_message_bytes` (Number) Largest message the producer sends, in bytes. Defaults to `1048576`.
- `max_retry` (Number) Delivery attempts before the stream is terminated. Defaults to `3`.
- `mechanisms` (String) SASL mechanism: `PLAIN`, `GSSAPI`, `SCRAM-SHA-256`, `SCRAM-SHA-512` or `OAUTHBEARER`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SASL password.
- `protocol` (String) `plaintext`, `ssl`, `sasl_ssl` or `sasl_plaintext`. Defaults to `plaintext`.
- `retry_interval_sec` (Number) Seconds between delivery attempts. Defaults to `1`.
- `ssl_ca_pem` (String) PEM-encoded CA certificate that signed the brokers' certificates.
- `ssl_certificate_pem` (String) PEM-encoded client certificate.
- `ssl_key_pem` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded client private key.
- `timeout_sec` (Number) Seconds to wait for the brokers to acknowledge. Defaults to `30`.
- `username` (String) SASL user.


<a id="nestedatt--destination--postgres"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination.postgres`

Required:

- `database` (String) Database name.
- `host` (String) Database host.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Database password.
- `table_name` (String) Table the rows are written to.
- `username` (String) Database user.

Optional:

- `max_retry` (Number) Delivery attempts before the stream is terminated. Defaults to `3`.
- `port` (Number) Database port. Defaults to `5432`.
- `retry_interval_sec` (Number) Seconds between delivery attempts. Defaults to `1`.
- `sslmode` (String) `require` or `disable`. Defaults to `require`.


<a id="nestedatt--destination--s3"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination.s3`

Required:

- `access_key` (String) Access key id.
- `bucket` (String) Bucket name.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key.

Optional:

- `compression` (String) `none` or `gzip`. Defaults to `none`.
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint host. Defaults to `s3.amazonaws.com`.
- `file_type` (String) `.json` or `.parquet`. Defaults to `.json`.
- `max_retry` (Number) Delivery attempts before the stream is terminated. Defaults to `3`.
- `object_prefix` (String) Prefix added to each object name. It is joined to the file name with no separator, so end it with `/` to write into a folder. Defaults to ``.
- `region` (String) Bucket region, for example `us-east-1`.
- `retry_interval_sec` (Number) Seconds between delivery attempts. Defaults to `1`.
- `use_ssl` (Boolean) Connect to the endpoint over TLS. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedatt--destination--webhook"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination.webhook`

Required:

- `url` (String) URL the batches are posted to.

Optional:

- `compression` (String) `none` or `gzip`. Defaults to `none`.
- `headers` (Map of String) Extra request headers. Omit the attribute rather than setting an empty map.
- `max_retry` (Number) Delivery attempts before the stream is terminated. Defaults to `3`.
- `post_timeout_sec` (Number) Seconds to wait for the receiver to respond. Defaults to `30`.
- `retry_interval_sec` (Number) Seconds between delivery attempts. Defaults to `1`.
- `security_token` (String, Sensitive) Token used to sign each request, so the receiver can verify it came from Quicknode. When omitted on the primary destination, Quicknode generates one and this attribute reports it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Streams are imported by id. Importing doesn't start or pause the stream, so
# set status to match its current state.
terraform import quicknode_stream.transfers 0b4a6f8e-3c1d-4e2a-9f7b-5d6c8e1a2b3c
```
